ui.rotation.method: A period's change runs from its first session's open to its last session's close, on split-adjusted prices from the long-term daily store; the gap from the previous close is not included. Statistics use complete past years only. An ETF that started later (XLC from June 2018), or whose local history starts later, counts the years it has, and N says how many. The excess subtracts the S&P 500's change over the same sessions. Each year ranks only the ETFs with a value that year, and equal values share a rank. Industry groups without a primary ETF are left out. Results are kept for 24 hours and then recomputed from local prices; this page never fetches prices for them.
ui.sectors.title: Sectors
ui.sectors.scope: These ETFs track the matching sectors of the S&P 500; they do not cover the whole US stock market. Price returns, adjusted for splits only.
ui.sectors.column.name: Sector
ui.sectors.status.missing: No daily price for one of the compared sessions yet.
ui.sectors.status.before_listing: The ETF had not started trading on the starting session.
ui.sectors.status.no_prices: Daily prices are not fetched yet.
ui.sectors.basis_intraday: Latest regular-session quote ({{time}}) against the {{start}} close
ui.sectors.heatmap_rule: Tile area ranks the changes: weight = 0.2 + 0.8 × (r − lowest) / max(highest − lowest, s), with s = 1% today, 2% for 1 week, 4% for 1 month and 8% for 3 months and year to date; the smallest tile is a fifth of the largest. Color shows the direction (the up or down color) and its depth the size of the change.
ui.sectors.chart_rule: Completed sessions from {{start}} to {{end}}; all charts share one date axis. Scroll or drag to zoom; the crosshair follows across charts.
ui.sectors.method: 1 week, 1 month and 3 months start at the close of the latest session on or before the same calendar date 7 days, 1 month or 3 months earlier; year to date starts at the previous year's last close. Daily prices come from the long-term store, which keeps ten years back from today; an ETF it does not hold yet is fetched once (this year and the past 10 complete years) and kept for 24 hours. Monthly and interval analyses of these ETFs reuse the same prices.
ui.sectors.no_chart: No daily prices in this range.
ui.sectors.group_scope: Each industry group is ranked by one primary ETF. These ETFs come from several issuers and follow their own indexes, so the coverage label says how closely each one matches its GICS industry group; reference rows are shown for comparison and never ranked. Price returns, adjusted for splits only.
ui.sectors.group_method: Only primary ETFs are ranked and shown on the heatmap and K-lines; heatmap areas compare the groups on screen. Pending groups have no suitable ETF yet and stay at the end. Group ETFs are fetched only when this level is opened.
ui.sectors.too_many: {{count}} ETFs selected; an analysis takes at most {{max}}.
ui.sectors.coverage_rule.complete: The ETF tracks the whole industry group.
ui.sectors.coverage_rule.partial: The ETF tracks only part of the industry group, such as one of its industries.
ui.sectors.coverage_rule.reference: The ETF's index differs from the industry group in scope or weighting; it is a close reference, not the group.
ui.sectors.coverage_rule.pending: No suitable ETF yet; the group is listed but not ranked.
ui.sectors.fetch_rule.no_data: The provider returned no daily prices for this ETF; nothing is filled in.
ui.sectors.fetch_rule.failed: Today's request ended without daily prices; it is tried again after the next close.
ui.sectors.etf_note.FDN: internet companies (a theme, not the group)
ui.sectors.method_title: How the periods and the daily prices work
ui.sectors.insider_rule_one: Open-market purchases minus sales (Form 4 codes P and S) by insiders of the companies in this row, by trade date over the last day, amounts as on the Insider overview. Companies count by their current classification: the S&P 500 list's GICS sector first, else the saved Yahoo sector; industry groups count only companies with a GICS sub-industry.
ui.sectors.insider_rule_other: Open-market purchases minus sales (Form 4 codes P and S) by insiders of the companies in this row, by trade date over the last {{count}} days, amounts as on the Insider overview. Companies count by their current classification: the S&P 500 list's GICS sector first, else the saved Yahoo sector; industry groups count only companies with a GICS sub-industry.

ui.sectors.insider_ungrouped_other: {{count}} companies of this sector have no GICS sub-industry and are not counted in any group
